text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following a breathtaking, electrifying<n>race, Taiki
Shuttle conquers the<n>Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her thrilling performance leaves the<n>spectators
positively spellbound.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But her legs aren't ready to slow<n>down just yet.
She's on to the race<n>to crown the autumn King of
the<n>Mile—the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle faces two major<n>challenges—to
conquer both the spring<n>and autumn G1 mile races,
and to win<n>the autumn G1 sprint!
